closures: record harness_headers.py's read of eg_b7_seam_hubs.py under inert_reads

#2017 added tools/audit/harnesses/eg_b7_seam_hubs.py. tests/harness_headers.py
reads every harness file; the file is INERT, so the read belongs under
`inert_reads` beside the other tools/audit/harnesses/* entries. main's closures
job fails with "INERT READS UNDER-APPROXIMATED" on exactly this pair.
